name: graph-plot
title: Plot
description: Line or area made of columns. Cap is █, fill is ░.

@utility graph-frame.background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--graph-frame) 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px), repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--graph-frame) 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px), repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--graph-frame) 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px), repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--graph-frame) 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px)
